messages:
Alex: Hey folks — thinking of running a quick office foosball tourney this Friday after standup (4:30pm). 8-team bracket, single elimination. Who's in? :table_tennis:
Priya: I can play! Count me in. Also can help run the bracket. :raised_hands:
Miguel: I’ll join if we can do best-of-3 for semis/final. Otherwise I’ll protest with snacks. :pretzel:
Jenn: I’ll bring snacks. Bagels or empanadas? Vote with reactions. :bagel: :taco:
Sam: Wait also — anyone wanted to start the fantasy hockey pool this weekend? Could do buy-in + winner gets the foosball trophy for the month. :hockey_stick_and_puck: :trophy:
Nora: remote here — happy to join via camera for cheering and moral support (2am my time but I’ll suffer). :zzz:
Alex: Good call on semis best-of-3, Miguel. Also love the cross-contest prize idea, Sam. I’ll set up a quick sign-up Google sheet and post the link. calendar-bot: Added preliminary event to #calendar (Fri 16:30) — RSVP required.
Priya: Bracket template (copy and fill):
```
1 vs 8
4 vs 5
3 vs 6
2 vs 7
```
Miguel: If we get >8 people we can do two pods and a final. Also thinking rules: no phone-checking while playing, 1 minute breaks between games.
Jenn: Bagels win for me. I’ll bring cream cheese + fruit. Also bringing a small first-aid kit (paper cuts from over-exuberant celebration). :bandage:
Sam: Fantasy pool: $10 buy-in, standard scoring, roster lock Sat 11:59pm. I’ll post a draft link after lunch. Winner gets $70 + foosball trophy for wall of fame.
Nora: Can someone pin a photo spot so I can photoshop myself into the winners' circle later? :camera_with_flash: :laughing:
Alex: Haha yes. Also can a volunteer run the camera for remote players? Might be worth hooking up the GoPro. Anyone?
Priya: I can handle the stream and scoreboard. I’ll set up a small OBS scene and drop the sheet in.
calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Foosball + Snacks" in 48 hours (Fri 16:30).
Miguel: Perfect. I’m in for snacks too. :thumbsup:
Jenn: Bagels + empanadas both available. I’ll bring both and let people choose.
Sam: Pool link up in ~2 hours. Who’s in for buy-in? React with :moneybag: and I’ll DM for Venmo.
Alex: OK — I’ll post the sheet and the pool link shortly. Thanks team! Quick, chaotic, fun. :confetti_ball:
